english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for bottled mineral water.
Use this specifically for mineral water as a drink.
Use 礦泉水 specifically for mineral water rather than ordinary drinking water.

examples.english: I bought two bottles of mineral water at the convenience store and put them in the fridge.
examples.traditional: 我去便利店買咗兩樽礦泉水，放喺雪櫃度。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 bin6 lei6 dim3 maai5 zo2 loeng5 zeon1 kwong3 cyun4 seoi2 fong3 hai2 syut3 gwai6 dou6

examples.english: Mineral water is the most refreshing drink in summer.
examples.jyutping: haa6 tin1 jam2 kwong3 cyun4 seoi2 zeoi3 gaai2 hot3

examples.english: I want to buy a bottle of mineral water.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zi1 kwong3 cyun4 seoi2
